notes: Prerelease 3.0.0-beta.10 is a test version of Printer Bot 3.0 and it can have mistakes. It needs no new import. New: a second layout for Letter paper. Under each printer on Letter paper the dock has a row, Letter layout. Scaled like 80 mm is the layout as before and stays the default. Large message puts a small picture, the amount, the name and the time at the top and the platform logo, small, at the bottom, and gives all the space between to the message and its pictures. Each printer has its own layout. Rolls and thermal printers print as before. Reload the dock after the update.
